summary: Execute customer-supplied redaction script against timeboxed production session slice in secured sandbox
related_slack_threads: #support: thread TS03K9F6 about Acadia redaction request
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (AcadiaHealth AI) has provided a redaction/sanitization script that they claim will remove PHI from returned inference payloads. They are requesting Redwood run their script against a timeboxed, minimal production session slice to validate that the script performs as expected before the customer applies it on their side.

Impact / Business justification:
- Customer will not proceed with data correction until Redwood validates the redaction output.
- This affects an enterprise contract renewal and a compliance attestation they must supply to their regulator.

Proposed scope (minimization):
- Time range: 2026-02-12T00:00:00Z through 2026-02-14T23:59:59Z (48 hours).
- Session filter: customer_id=acadia-001 AND route=/v1/chat/stream AND status=200
- Max sessions: 250 sessions, capped at 5MB total plaintext.
- No free-text searches outside the session IDs enumerated below.

Controls requested from SRE/Security/Privacy team:
1) Create ephemeral sandbox (ephemeral project) isolated from prod control plane with VPC isolation and egress blocked.
2) Mount an encrypted, read-only copy of the selected session slice. Data must be KMS-wrapped and accessible only to the sandbox compute.
3) Execute customer-supplied script inside the sandbox under an approved runner account with session-level audit logging. No outbound network allowed.
4) All console output and transformed artifacts must be captured to a KMS-encrypted storage bucket and then scanned by Redwood privacy reviewer before any transfer.
5) Retention: sandbox and artifacts to be destroyed after 7 days unless approved for extended review.
6) Legal must sign-off on the exact script content and customer consent before execution.

Customer consent and attachments:
- Customer provided email consent and checksum of script (attached in SecureFiles ticket). Reference: Acadia Support PROV-45321 (attached).

Required approvals list:
- Security (sandbox risk review)
- Privacy / DPO (data minimization & handling)
- Legal (consent verification and liability signoff)
- SRE (resource provisioning and audit)

Deliverables expected:
- A short validation report (1 page) summarizing: inputs used, script version, pre/post sample counts (redacted), and confirmation of claimed redaction heuristics.
- Artifacts: sanitized output sample (max 10 samples) after privacy review.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: customer-supplied code may contain exfil or crypto that subverts KMS. Mitigation: run in fully network-isolated environment, container runtime with seccomp profile, and static scan of the script before execution.
- Risk: accidental over-exposure of PII in logs. Mitigation: enable structured logging only and redact all runtime env vars; preserve a narrow audit trail.

Point of contact:
- Customer success: Priya Menon (pri.menton@acadia.ai)
- Requestor (Redwood): Aisha Kapoor (aisha@redwood.com)
investigation_notes:
2026-03-01: Security ran static scan on the provided Python script; flagged uses of 'subprocess' and 'open' patterns. Customer confirmed script is a thin wrapper and provided an alternative v2 with subprocess removed.
2026-03-02: Privacy reviewed the sample selectors and reduced session set from 250 -> 120 to further minimize exposure.
2026-03-03: SRE prepared terraform template for ephemeral sandbox but blocked on Legal sign-off for running third-party code in-house.
comments: 2026-03-01 | Miguel Ortega (SRE): Collected minimal session slice (ids attached) and staged read-only snapshot in ksandbox-eu. Waiting on Security static-scan OK for script v2.
2026-03-01 | Lina Chen (Security): Static scan found 'subprocess' usage in script v1. Requested customer remove exec-style calls. Please do not run until v2 is supplied and reviewed.

2026-03-02 | Priya Menon (Customer Success, Acadia): Customer agreed and uploaded script v2 to SecureFiles. They acknowledge Redwood will run the script in network-isolated environment and will accept only redacted outputs for review.
2026-03-03 | Ravi Desai (Privacy): Approved reduced session set (120 sessions). Legal must confirm indemnity language before execution. Marking this ticket blocked for legal sign-off.
resolution_notes: Pending legal indemnity approval and security sign-off on script v2. If approved, plan: 1) spin up sandbox (runbook RBX-012), 2) run script with 2-person audit (SRE + Privacy), 3) generate validation report, 4) destroy environment within 7 days.
